name: Modern Health
short_description: Modern Health is a B2B enterprise mental health platform with coaching, therapy, and global coverage in 200+ countries.
long_description: Modern Health is a global mental health benefits platform serving enterprise employers in over 200 countries with support for 80+ languages. The platform offers a full continuum of care including digital self-guided content, certified coaching, licensed therapy, and psychiatry services. Modern Health emphasizes a coaching-first model, with fast access to care (typically within one day) and high engagement rates. The platform is designed as a comprehensive EAP replacement with modern technology, personalized care navigation, and robust employer reporting on utilization and outcomes without compromising individual privacy.
one_liner: Global enterprise mental health platform with coaching, therapy, and 200+ country coverage.

Companies wanting coaching-focused mental health benefits
Employers prioritizing fast global access to care (1-day average)
